summary.name: Motion Poster (normalized label, category Motion Design and Cinematography). It was normalized from a moving street-poster description, so the label is not an original source title.
summary.visualIdentity: Design a complete static poster first, with a clear headline, imagery, supporting information and negative space. Then animate through local loops, layout changes or controlled boundary crossings, keeping useful still frames. Medium, texture and typography are unspecified beyond these cues.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: suited to announcements, and the combination notes name event and film posters as best fits. Motion-reference lists include Motion Poster alongside kinetic typography and music-synchronized styles. Inferred: short poster-style videos and looping interactive poster pages where a readable still must persist.
summary.limitations: Motion must not hide the headline or leave unreadable fragments. Concise copy suits the reference actions; dense explanatory text is not suited. Hybrid print or depth additions must keep still frames useful, and gradients should be avoided with screen-print layers. Source reviews covered sampled seconds only, with no continuous motion or audio verified.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent: choose the ground from subject, lighting and mood. No approved exact colors were supplied. Optional example tokens are #F4EDDF background, #273B44 foreground and #B66A4B accent. Foreground-on-background contrast is 10.04:1; accent-as-background with background text is 3.499:1, decorative only. Verify composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Optional references: motion-007 pinned recomposition, motion-037 phrase scatter, motion-038 punctuation zoom, motion-039 radial logo burst, and motion-040 word smash cuts with burst-swap and squash-flip variants. Each needs scene support and may be omitted. Video state must derive from composition time; pointer, scroll and live lightbox input apply only to interactive delivery.
summary.audio: Audio is optional and unspecified; no soundtrack, voiceover or music was supplied. Silence is valid. Inferred: restrained accents or ambience may clarify word cuts and reading holds, and any voice must not compete with the headline. Music synchronization requires inspected audio, and no beat or speech timing has been verified.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads were supplied, so copy, imagery, fonts and any approved poster artwork are unspecified. Do not invent product copy or a brand mark. Source recordings served only as visual evidence. Cropper.js can prepare raster framing but cannot extract subjects. PhotoSwipe applies only to an interactive web gallery needing an image lightbox.
summary.combinations: Suggested hybrid: style-051 screen-print spot-color layers using three inks (navy, rust, cream paper), revealed sequentially and then looped; avoid gradients. Suggested hybrid: style-101 restrained image parallax with static text; avoid headline parallax. These are optional suggestions, not requirements.
summary.productionApproach: Default pipeline is HyperFrames: a paused GSAP timeline per composition, validated and exported through its CLI. Remotion is a conditional fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. Use HTML/CSS and SVG for the style renderer, GSAP as the motion engine, and chroma-js for contrast checks. Keep seeded randomness, seek-test forward, backward and direct, and verify sampled frames, audio and loop endpoints.
